hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''); sys.exit(2 if any(x in p for x in ['.env','.git/','addons/gut/']) else 0)"

if command -v godot >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f addons/gut/gut_cmdln.gd ]; then godot --headless -s addons/gut/gut_cmdln.gd -gexit > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'GUT SUITE FAILED - fix before stopping.' >&2; exit 2; }; else python3 tools/gdcheck.py > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'gdcheck FAILED - fix before stopping.' >&2; exit 2; }; fi
